spotlight.title: Rock On Harris - CBE Edition
spotlight.description: Rock On Harris - CBE Edition brings the ultimate musical experience to Kozhikode. Join us for an unforgettable evening of rock music featuring Harris and his band. The event will showcase both classic hits and new compositions in a spectacular venue with state-of-the-art sound.

bestOfIndia.title: Rockstar DSP LIVE in Bengaluru
bestOfIndia.description: Devi Sri Prasad, popularly known as Rockstar DSP, is set to electrify Bengaluru with his high-energy performance. Experience the magic of his film hits and independent tracks live with a full orchestra and spectacular dance performances.

bestOfIndia.title: Arijit Singh Concert - Mumbai
bestOfIndia.description: Arijit Singh, the voice that has captured millions of hearts, brings his soulful melodies to Mumbai. Join the musical journey through his greatest hits and experience the emotion and passion that defines his music in this intimate concert setting.

bestOfIndia.title: Sunburn Festival Goa 2025
bestOfIndia.description: Sunburn Goa, Asia's premiere electronic dance music festival, returns to the beaches of Vagator for its 2025 edition. Experience three days of music, featuring the world's top DJs, stunning visual productions, and the magical Goa atmosphere.

bestOfIndia.title: Tomorrowland India Experience
bestOfIndia.description: Tomorrowland, the world's most magical festival, comes to India for an extraordinary experience. The legendary Belgian festival brings its incredible production, immersive themes, and spectacular lineup to create an unforgettable journey for music lovers.
